title: Partner Calendar Terms: Weekend Service Charge — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
The weekend charge of a Wayfare partner work order on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report is read from the day of the week the work order was put on the evidence ledger: a Sunday takes the Sunday charge; a Saturday takes the Saturday charge; a weekday takes no weekend charge.

*Which date decides the day?* The date of the cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger; where more than one is on the ledger, the latest.

*How much is charged?* $30.00 on a Sunday, $20.00 on a Saturday, nothing on a weekday.

| Day the work order was put on the evidence ledger | Weekend charge |
|---|---|
| Sunday | $30.00 |
| Saturday | $20.00 |
| Monday to Friday | none |

*How does the charge enter the price?* As a fixed amount added to the work order's price.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

| Work order date | Day of the week | Weekend charge |
|---|---|---|
| 3 January 2026 | Saturday | $20.00 |
| 4 January 2026 | Sunday | $30.00 |
| 5 January 2026 | Monday | none |
